links.title: O-uchi-gaeshi on the IJF technique reference

about.en: The counter to O-uchi-gari: as uke reaps deep inside, and before the reap is complete, tori uses the attacked leg to sweep uke's hooking leg out from under them and throws them onto their back. Classified by the Kodokan as a foot technique, because the leg does the work.

en: Counter before the reap takes your weight
Sweep with the leg they are hooking
Their hooking leg is the target
Your partner attacks O-uchi-gari, hooking their right leg deep inside your left.
Answer before the reap is complete, while their right leg is still hooked round your left.
Use your left leg, the one they are hooking, to sweep their right leg out from under them.
They fall on their back where they stood; keep the sleeve and lower them under control.

receiving.en: Before your reap can finish, the leg you hooked sweeps your hooking leg away and leaves you on one leg. The fall is straight backwards, so it is a full back breakfall: chin tucked, arms ready, and let the held sleeve turn you slightly onto one side if it can.

viNotes.en: Their hook is deep inside your leg, so you know exactly where their attacking leg is. Sweep it with the leg it is hooking while you can still feel it, before the reap takes your weight. The whole exchange happens with legs touching, so nothing has to be judged across a gap.

cue.en: The big inside reap is answered: the attacked leg sweeps the hooking leg out from under its maker.
